title: feat(news): group community models and agents in the community post
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Community news posts now put 🧩 Models before 🤖 Agents. Agent entries show their base model’s catalog name instead of inherited price or paid-only status, and report additions, removals, base-model changes, and new capabilities. Owner-entered base-model text, which Enter allows up to 253 characters, reaches the writer only when it matches a catalog name or alias; aliases are normalized to catalog names. All 30 current agents with a base model resolve. In an unsent same-week preview, the number of compared agent entries fell from 7 to 4 because 3 had only followed a base-model price change.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel-art garden newsroom, Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, wears tiny editor’s glasses, and sorts two paper stacks labeled 'MODELS' and 'AGENTS' beside a little agent card pointing to its base-model card. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with chunky sprites, pixel flowers, and a prominent lime green (#ecf874) desk lamp glow against a warm cream background.
